page.title: Warehouse Fleets
page.descr: Texts of the Warehouse Fleets extension
page.t: One-shot mining trip for the WarehouseFleet behaviour.
WarehouseFleet ships will only buy from NPC stations if the player account will remain above this threshold \(value in millions\)
Enable auto-transfer of excess credits from warehouse accounts to player account

Trade orders may fail and leave cargo unhandled in the ships. Select the method of cargo auto-handling below:

Refund: Wares are refunded back to the player based on their average prices. Shows up as a transfer on the transaction log

Teleport: wares are teleported to the warehouse

Destroy: wares are destroyed

Return: wares are returned to the warehouse through trade orders

Drop: wares are dropped

Independent fleets: WarehouseFleet ships will be displayed on the top level of the map/property menus.

Subordinates of warehouse: fleets will be displayed as subordinates under their respective warehouses.

Switching this setting immediately attaches/detaches all existing fleets.
Default Fleet Settings \(applied when creating new WarehouseFleets\)
Applies this setting to all existing WarehouseFleets.

Avoids scheduling inefficient trips. No ship will be scheduled that uses less than the specified cargo space. Setting this value too low can cause performance degradation. Setting the value too high might prevent/delay balancing of low volume wares. Ships supplying build storages or restocking drone/ammo resources may ignore this setting if they fully satisfy the request. Smaller transports may still be added to a trip to the same station that meets the threshold.
Penalty per gate jump for NPC trades and surplus sales, to keep travel distances short
Reduces the attractivity of mining operations in other sectors to keep travel distances short
Even out wares between your warehouses by fill level. 0 = off.
Deliver resources to, collect products from and restock drones/ammo for your non-warehouse stations. 0 = off.
Buy from / sell to NPC stations at 5% margin or more. Respects the trade rules of the warehouse offers. 0 = off.
Sell stock of the home warehouse above the keep level \(see Sell Surplus: Keep\) to NPC stations, never below your own sell price. Ignores trade rules. 0 = off.

Share of the storage target of each ware that is never sold as surplus. Everything above it may be sold to NPC stations in the fleet targets, even if the ware trade rule forbids NPC trade \(e.g. player-only\). Never sells below the warehouse sell price. 100% disables sell-out.
Fill the stations in Supply Targets \(e.g. shipyards\). 0 = off.
Deliver to your build storages. 0 = off.
Mining trips for mining-capable ships. 0 = off.
S-sized ships should dock at their home warehouse while waiting for new delivery jobs
M-sized ships should dock at their home warehouse while waiting for new delivery jobs
L-sized ships should dock at their home warehouse while waiting for new delivery jobs
